thread:
maya: Heads-up — we're scheduling a staged deprecation for the v1 API behavior that affects streaming and model fallback. Need docs owners + a migration playbook. TL;DR: docs + SDK snippets + smoke tests.
jon: On it. Can you spell out the exact user-visible change so examples/prs match? :eyes:
maya: Yes — v1 streaming will stop returning partial tokens for models X/Y; users should switch to the v2 streaming shape. Also model aliases for embeddings will map differently, so sample embed code must call `models.embed-v2` (not `embed-legacy`).
elaine: I can own the client-side snippet updates for JS and Python. Do we have a canonical snippet for streaming -> v2? If not, I'll draft one. 
jon: Draft would be great. Make it tiny: show a streaming loop and the new `stream.format = 'json-chunks'` flag. Example:
```
// JS streaming example
const res = await client.stream.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-stream-1', stream: true, stream_format: 'json-chunks' });
for await (const chunk of res) { console.log(chunk.delta); }
```
elaine: Nice. I'll mirror for Python and add a short note about `max_latency` change.
sean: Docs QA here — we need automated smoke tests that load the snippet, run in CI against the canary backend, and assert no 4xx. Can we add a `docs/smoke/streaming_migration.sh`? Minimal command:
```
./scripts/run_snippet.sh js/streaming.mjs --endpoint canary
```
maya: Yes — docs-bot, please create the PR checklist template for this deprecation that includes: snippet updates, link redirects, changelog + in-page deprecation banner, smoke test, SDK release note.
docs-bot: Created checklist template `deprecations/staged_playbook.md` and added to repo. :white_check_mark:
jon: Timeline proposal: Draft snippets by EOD Wednesday (maya/elaine), PRs open by Friday, smoke tests green Monday, public notice next Wednesday. Thoughts?
sean: Timeline sounds reasonable. I'll schedule a canary run for next Tuesday and reserve resources on Dedicated for the smoke window.
maya: One more thing — model swap guidance for customers using alias fallback. Add a short table in the playbook with recommended replacements and cost notes. I'll sketch the table in the PR description.
elaine: For SDKs: add a deprecation warning in the client when `v1` streaming is used, include `DEPRECATION_LINK` to the migration playbook. We should also publish a tiny changelog entry in the SDK releases.
jon: I'll own the PR review queue. If you tag me `@jon` in the PRs I will triage the docs, smoke, and examples. Let's keep the PR titles like: `docs: migration playbook — streaming v1 -> v2 snippets` so they're searchable.
maya: Awesome. I'll open a meta PR that links all sub-PRs and includes the checklist. If anyone wants to split ownership of snippets, ping me here. :thumbsup:
